chunks: Hammad narrated from al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

Ali عليه السلام ruled regarding two men, one of whom restrained while the other killed. He said: The killer is to be executed, and the other is to be imprisoned until he dies in grief, just as he held him until he died in grief.

key_terms.رَجُلَيْنِ: two men involved in the case
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ الْقَاتِلُ: the direct killer is executed in legal retaliation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one person restrains a victim while another person kills him?
ai.summary: This hadith records a judicial ruling from Imam Ali عليه السلام concerning joint participation in murder, where one person restrained the victim and another carried out the killing. It establishes differentiated liability: execution for the direct killer and perpetual imprisonment for the accomplice who enabled the killing.
